You own: web/src/components/Today.tsx, web/src/lib/today.ts, web/src/components/Routines.tsx, web/src/components/routines/* (FlowGraph.tsx keeps its When/Then/Always lane structure; restyle only), web/src/components/VoiceCall.tsx. New routines will default to mode "ask" (the lead changes that now). Shared client state lives in web/src/components/routines/live.ts (useLive, proposals, would-handle, undo).

Build:
1. Today, automation where decisions happen (calm, one quiet line each, never a panel):
   a. If routines have pending proposals: a quiet line under the decision area / on All clear: "Your routine ‘<name>’ prepared 3 emails to PackRight · review" → opens a review sheet in the same style as the existing EmailReview in Today.tsx (to, subject, editable text per proposal; "Send all 3" primary + per item "Send"/"Skip"); sending = POST accept (the email content is what the routine prepared; if the proposal has editable text and the backend has no field for edits, show it read-only and say so).

   c. After a decision (Done view, existing): keep the offer "N more like this … Handle them the same way?"; "Show me how" opens the Routines sheet and drafts; make sure the drafted routine starts in "Ask me" and say so in one line ("It will prepare them; you send with one tap").
   d. All clear: "N handled by your routines overnight · see · undo" (exists) + "N waiting for your OK · review" when proposals exist.
   e. Voice drafts ("Drafted from your call") surface as the same quiet line.
2. Restyle the Routines sheet and the flow diagram to the Today design: Instrument Sans sizes, whitespace instead of borders where possible, fewer frames and chips, the routine green only for routine-done things, the guard calm (dashed hairline), the trust selector as quiet text segmented control ("Ask me · Do it and tell me · Do it quietly"), proposals and drafts consistent with 1a. Keep all features (flow/steps, edit by words, drag, palette, review diff, test run, undo, delete, show code).
Never accept proposals, approve, or send on real data in your checks; mock with Playwright page.route (proposals etc.). Verify: cd web && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && npm run build; screenshots 390x844 and 1440x900 into /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/auto-today/. Final report with screenshots.

        shot("4-after-approve")

        page.goto(f"{BASE}/"); page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle"); page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
        shot("5-allclear")
        # Routines page: draft from "Show me how"
        mode["clear"] = False
        page.goto(f"{BASE}/routines?draft={PACK[0]}"); page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle"); page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

        page.goto(f"{BASE}/routines?routine=r1"); page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle"); page.wait_for_timeout(2500)

        sec = page.locator("#routine-r1")

        sec.get_by_role("menuitem", name="Tell me on Teams").locator("visible=true").first.click(); page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        sec.screenshot(path=f"{OUT}/{tag}-9-change-review.png")
        b.close()

Everything you asked for is built. `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && npm run build` passes, nothing is committed or pushed, and the voice flow is the one part I haven't run (no mic in my checks). Screenshots at 390x844 and 1440x900 are in `/Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/auto-today/`, with the script `shoot.py` beside them. Every send, accept and approve in those checks was mocked, and none reached the server.

**Automation in Today** (one quiet green line each, no panels)
- **On a decision:** up to three lines can show: "Your routine ‘X’ handles cases like this · let it · ask me first", "Your routine ‘X’ prepared 3 emails to PackRight · review", and "Drafted from your call: ‘…’ · review".
- **Review sheet:** it follows the email review layout, with To, Subject and the text for each item. Long emails fold after a few lines. "Send all 3" stays pinned at the bottom, each item has "Send" / "Skip", and a sent item shows "Sent at HH:MM".
  - The accept endpoint takes no edits, so the text is read-only and the sheet says so.
  - A failed accept now shows as an error. Before, the server returned 200 with `ok: false` and the UI took that as success.
- **"How it decided"** in that sheet goes to `/routines?routine=<id>`.
- **Done view:** "Show me how" goes to `/routines?draft=<cardId>`. The line now reads "It starts by asking: it prepares them, you send with one tap."
- **New routines start in "Ask me":** drafts save with that mode explicitly, and you can change it before turning one on.
- **All clear:** "N handled by your routines · see · undo". Proposals from one routine get the named line; from several, one "N waiting for your OK · review" line.
- **Needs you list:** the header now reads "Needs you · 9 decisions". A folded row shows "5 like this, one decision each" under its title.

**Routines is now its own page**, `/routines`, in a centred column about 1040 px wide:
- The order is: waiting for your OK, the draft from your decision, drafts from calls, your routines, then "Automate a decision you made".
- Each routine is one view: the When/Then/Always diagram is also the editor. Phones get the vertical flow.
  - Editing: × removes a condition or step, Then steps drag to reorder, and "+ add" offers the five steps you listed plus "Ask for a status".
  - Every edit goes through test run, before/after on the diagram, then Apply or Keep as is.
  - Below the diagram are "Change it in your words" and a collapsed "Show the code".
- The Flow/Steps toggle, Expand and the flyout sheet are gone.
- Proposals, would-handle and voice drafts live in one shared store (`routines/live.ts`), refreshed on every page.

**Voice (`VoiceCall.tsx` + `Today.tsx`)**
- **prepare_decision:** an email option opens the email review with "Say ‘yes’ or tap Send". Anything else shows the summary inline as "On the call: … Say ‘yes’ to go ahead". Both close when the call ends or the decision is made.
- **show_on_screen** is answered in the browser, never relayed. It opens the document or system side of the source, the other options, or the email review.
- **Guard:** `decide` is answered locally with "Wait for the person to answer first." unless the person spoke since the last prepare result. A turn whose transcript comes back empty doesn't count.
- **Done waits for the call to end.** During the call, the decision stays on screen with "Done. …" in place of the buttons. If the person taps Send mid-call, the assistant is told it's done so it doesn't decide again.
- **Not tested end to end:** no mic in my checks, and your restart for show_on_screen is still pending. A live call is the open check. Also, an email edited on screen and then confirmed by voice sends the original draft, because `decide` takes no text.

**Outside my files**
- `App.tsx`: the `/routines` route, "Show me how" now goes to that page, and the sheet state is gone.
- `TopBar.tsx`: Routines is a normal link with its badge, and the unused prop was removed.
